reason: I already reorder my own brand when it runs out and my drawer is full of half-used bottles, so I'm not adding another one. The lab report is a nice touch but I'd have to take their word it's real.
objection: Is it really tested, or just marketing? A report on their own page is still them telling me it's good, and I've never heard of this brand.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the named lab's own site confirm the report, plus real reviews from moms I trust on TikTok, and a cheaper single box to try without a big commitment.
